summary: Elevra Lithium Ltd (formerly Sayona Mining Ltd) filed a Form 6-K announcing the scheduled release of its FY26 financial results and Annual Report on 28 August 2026, with an investor webcast. The filing is a routine earnings date notice and contains no special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, restructuring, or other corporate action. The registrant is the filer. No deal terms, board recommendations, or advisors are mentioned. The filing is purely informational and administrative, relating to standard financial reporting obligations for a foreign private issuer.
